Then generate an invoice for 1 of product p_sony_xm5_blk, which is 1 Sony XM5 black, using the SAVE15 coupon and PayPal, and send it to alice@company.com. Finally, use the invoice message to create a medium-priority app document and alert titled IoT Update and Purchase Summary on the app channel.
